title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for the deceleration magnitude must be 3 m/s².

title: Distance B to C
description: Essential: The final answer for the distance between points B and C must be 6 m.

title: Use of last-second motion
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply kinematic equations to the motion in the 2nd second before stopping to relate distance (4.5 m) to acceleration.

title: Velocity continuity at B
description: Important: The solution must correctly equate the constant velocity from A to B with the initial velocity at the start of deceleration at point B.

title: System of equations setup
description: Important: The solution must establish and solve the correct system relating total distance (60 m), total time (11 s), and the kinematic variables for both motion segments.

title: Time allocation
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly define and solve for the time spent in uniform motion (t1) and in deceleration (t2).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Deduct points if the student incorrectly uses a positive sign for acceleration during deceleration without clarifying it as a magnitude.

title: Misinterpreting '2nd second'
description: Pitfall: Deduct points if the student misinterprets the '2nd second before stopping', leading to an incorrect kinematic equation setup.
